answer: Sybil resistance requires a voyage with no shortcuts. Each identity crosses a weekly oasis with a fresh proof-of-work bound to that epoch's randomness — skipping an epoch breaks the chain, resetting the voyage to zero. The mirror verifies the full voyage history: clones each carry their own separate voyage cost, as a copied key cannot replay another's epochs. Rewards flow only to identities reaching each oasis without gaps, so per-identity cost scales with fleet size and voyage length. No shared state, no transferable credit — every fake identity must walk its own full voyage.
